meta.title: The Road Ahead
meta.description: KUL Enterprises runs one truck today and plans fifty by 2029. The plan in order, what has to happen first, and what does not change on the way. Licensed carrier in {location}, USDOT {usdot}.

opening.heading: One truck today. Fifty by 2029.
opening.body: Written in the order it has to happen, and nothing on it is dated until it is booked. The figures are updated the day they change.

leadFigure.label: Years driving
leadFigure.note: Eleven years hauling for other carriers before KUL took its first load.

facts.label: Trucks in service
facts.note: One tractor, on the road since 2026.

facts.label: Drivers
facts.note: Mark Brown, who also answers dispatch.

stages.title: The second truck
stages.body: A second tractor goes on the road once there is repeat freight to keep both loaded through a full month. Until that is true the money stays in maintenance and insurance on the first one.

stages.title: A second driver
stages.body: Hired on a verified work history and a clean motor vehicle record, held to the standards written on the safety page. Recruiting starts once the second truck is booked, not before.

stages.title: Dispatch cover
stages.body: A second person on the phone, so calls are answered while the first is driving. The number on this site does not change when that happens.

fixed.heading: What does not change at any size
items: Dispatch stays one phone number, answered by somebody who has driven the lane.
No load is accepted that cannot be run legally inside hours of service.
Delays come from us before they come from your receiver.

limits.heading: What this page is not
limits.body: There is no funding announcement here and no photographs of equipment KUL does not own. Nothing on it is a commitment to a customer.
